headline: No code change tonight: the 11-18 no-model guard is on main and today's sheet is healthy, but on 11-19 and 11-21 the NY high sheet held one bracket high from about 15:00 to 17:55 ET (p 0.61-0.77) with the exact DSM/CLI figure in hand and the market at 0.995, because the learned peak-behind-us table (0.909 at 16, 0.944 at 17) sits under the 0.95 gate.

findings.title: NY high afternoon held a bracket high until 18:00 with the exact figure in hand
findings.evidence: trail ny_high 11-19 15:00-17:55 65-66 p 0.62-0.64 vs DSM 64 (as of 16) and CLI 64, settled 63-64, market 0.995; 11-21 13:55-17:55 66+ p 0.61-0.77 vs DSM 65 and CLI 65, settled 64-65, market 0.995; both days collapse at 18:00 exactly; decided_by_exact needs peak_done.p >= 0.95, peak_stats.json ny_high p_done_cooling 16 0.909, 17 0.944, 18 0.972. Guardrail, not changed.

findings.evidence: kalshi_ny.json err -1.19, -0.53, -1.55, -1.23, -0.47, -2.45 (mean -1.24); misses 11-17, 11-18 (lock p 0.843), 11-21 (lock p 0.875); 11-22 +0.26 ended the run; last 30 days 21/30 negative, mean -0.44; today's bias +1.26
